confirmed.noteEn: Matched Han Yumen Pass record; not inferred from nearby features.

confirmed.name: 大方盘城
confirmed.note: 同址河仓城遗址交互弹窗标汉；敦煌市博物馆确认西汉始建。仅更正此城址轮廓，不外推附近墙体。
confirmed.noteEn: Same-site Hecang City is Han; used through Wei–Jin. Applies only to this outline.

confirmed.name: 阳关
confirmed.note: 本地汉长城阳关点与补充点相距约62米；阳关博物馆确认属汉代两关。此次未成功命中交互图对应弹窗，依据博物馆资料更正，不声称已核实地图记录。
confirmed.noteEn: Han attribution corroborated by Yangguan Museum; later reuse. Map popup not verified.
